fields.label: Description Intro
fields.name: cpt_resource_description_intro
fields.instructions: The introduction for the description shown on the listing page in larger bold text.

fields.label: Description
fields.name: cpt_resource_description
fields.instructions: The full description shown on the listing page alongside this resource card. Supports bold, lists, etc.

fields.label: Subtitle
fields.name: cpt_resource_subtitle
fields.instructions: Short subtitle shown below the title on the resource card. E.g. 'A founder's roadmap to trust and traction'

fields.label: Cover Image
fields.name: cpt_resource_cover_image
fields.instructions: The cover/preview image displayed inside the coloured resource card.

fields.label: Card Background Colour
fields.name: cpt_resource_accent_colour
fields.instructions: Background colour for the resource card.

fields.label: Card Text Colour
fields.name: cpt_resource_text_colour
fields.instructions: Text colour for the resource card title and subtitle.

fields.label: Download File
fields.name: cpt_resource_file
fields.instructions: Upload the file users will receive after submitting the gated access form.

fields.label: Download Button Text
fields.name: cpt_resource_button_text
fields.instructions: Text shown on the download button after form submission.

fields.label: Gated Download Form
fields.name: cpt_resource_gform_id
fields.instructions: Select the Gravity Form used for this resource's gated download.
